schedule.title: WinTax polling
schedule.description: WinTax is only polled on weekdays during the pickup and drop-off windows. Outside those times the portal is not contacted. Look-back and look-ahead days control which rides are fetched. A ride that WinTax still marks as on the way stays selected for the grace period after its end time.

home.title: Near home
home.description: The vehicle counts as near home when its GPS position is inside this circle. The pin starts on your home zone.
